title: Architectural Pedigree & Career Story
bioParagraphs: I am a Senior Technical Consultant and Principal Data/AI Architect with over a decade of hands-on experience designing, benchmarking, and shipping enterprise-scale data platforms, distributed streaming architectures, and deterministic generative AI systems.

Creator of AKEF (AI Knowledge Engineering Framework) — an open-source, 4-pass deterministic compiler translating Markdown specifications into multi-modal educational assets, automated lecture slides, and rich architectural diagrams.
Over my career, I have trained and mentored 5,000+ software engineers, data architects, and cloud specialists across premier IT services firms and tier-one academic engineering colleges.

corePillars.title: Cloud Data Platforms & Lakehouses
corePillars.description: Architecting petabyte-scale Medallion architectures using AWS S3, AWS Glue, Delta Lake, Snowflake, and Apache Spark.

corePillars.title: Deterministic Generative AI & Compilers
corePillars.description: Building stateful LangGraph agent pipelines, AST-driven deterministic knowledge engines, and vector retrieval systems.

corePillars.title: Enterprise Pedagogy & Engineering Leadership
corePillars.description: Upskilling corporate engineering cohorts across Tier-1 organizations with deep, systems-level curriculum.
